'''Free Trandoshans''' was an organization which operated within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], being [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Ronko Bist]].<ref name="GP4" /> Between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Clone Wars Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] took place between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Bist was maimed<ref name="GP4" /> by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="GP3">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 3|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 3]]</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] before being further arrested<ref name="GP4" /> by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Film III">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Afterward, Bist was taken to<ref name="GP4" /> the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[The Prism]] on the [[Diab 6|sixth moon]] of [[Diab]], which was operated by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="GP3" />

Following the Clone Wars,<ref name="GP4" /> around 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="VaderDate">The various ''Darth Vader'' miniseries released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] date themselves to a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to early in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY]], thus placing the ''Darth Vader'' comics, including ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]'', in around [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]].</ref> Skywalker, now known<ref name="Film III" /> as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, journeyed to The Prism in order to recruit its [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] into joining him in dethroning a [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]] transpiring on<ref name="GP4" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After a [[Mission to the Prism|riot]] took place throughout the prison, Bist was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the havoc. Later, as [[Cadet/Legends|Cadet]] [[Laurita Tohm]] investigated the bodies, he took note of Bist being the leader of the Free Trandoshans within the prison's [[Databank/Legends|databanks]].<ref name="GP4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Free Trandoshans were mentioned in the [[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 4|fourth issue]] of the [[2012]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]''. The issue was written by [[W. Haden Blackman]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="GP4" /> on [[August 22]], 2012.<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54123/star_wars_darth_vader_and_the_ghost_prison_2012_4|text=Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison (2012) #4}}</ref>
